title: Neo hackathon
note: Enriched from public web sources (personal sites, GitHub, LinkedIn search snippets, interviews, company pages, Devpost). The `confidence` field is about identity and whether the links belong to this person, not about personality. `personality_confidence` is how much public signal we had for work style and leadership. Personality fields are inferences from public professional presence for a canvas simulation, not psychological assessments. Low-confidence identity matches may be wrong. Dating apps were not used. Neo Hackathon 2026 project highlights summarize team submissions, not individual responsibilities, using the event's public Devpost gallery. A missing project highlight means no confirmed public attribution, not that the person did not participate.
